text:
Lena: Anand from AtlasPay uploaded their SIG/CAIQ + short compliance note in the intake form. Asking for POC that touches payment tokens and an EU-only deployment. link: https://files.redwood.example/atlaspay/sig_caig_q1.pdf
DeployBot: File saved to secure-bucket://intake/atlaspay/3432201023/ (sha256: ab12...) :white_check_mark:
Anand (AtlasPay): hi team — correct: POC will use tokenized payment ids (no PAN). We need EU data residency and BYOK for keys. POC duration 10 business days.
Priya (Security): Thanks. I need the network diagram, exact data fields, and which CAIQ sections AtlasPay marked as "requires redwood input". Also confirm whether this is hosted/dedicated/private.
Lena: AtlasPay prefers Hosted but will accept Dedicated if needed for BYOK. I'll ask which is quicker for a short POC.
Diego (SE): For tokenized flow we can do hosted with customer-managed keys (BYOK via KMS) but latency expectations matter. Ask them for expected qps and 95th p95 latency target. Context length?
Anand (AtlasPay): target p95 < 200ms, expected steady QPS ~10 req/s, occasional spikes to 60. Context not large, ~2k tokens.
Priya (Security): BYOK + EU-only triggers legal + DPA review. I'll assign the questionnaire to security and start the high-risk control passes. Please upload network diagram and sample anonymized tokens to `s3://redwood-secure/intake/atlaspay/3432201023/` (permissions: redwood/sec-team, eng-se).
Lena: will upload tonight. quick question: do we need a signed DPA before starting a POC?
LegalBot: If BYOK is requested and keys are customer-managed, DPA must be in place. For EU-only processing, also check data subprocessors clause. Pinged legal-reviews.
Diego (SE): For pricing, if we do a short Dedicated pool (2xA10) for 2 weeks plus support, rough ballpark $6k-9k for duration. Hosted eval with BYOK may be cheaper but needs legal signoff. I'll prepare a worksheet.
Priya (Security): I'm taking ownership of the CAIQ review. Assigning to Priya (security). I'll mark controls as: redwood-inference (owner) where applicable and flag outstanding ones.
Anand (AtlasPay): we'll drop the network diagram and anonymized samples by EOD. Also: compliance wants logging detail retention period — default 90 days, can that be reduced?
Priya (Security): We'll note retention options in the CAIQ answers. For EU-only retention can be set to 30/90 — discuss in kickoff.
Lena: scheduling kickoff for tomorrow 9am CET (works for AtlasPay) — attendees: @Diego, @Priya, legal rep (TBD). Agenda: POC scope, dataflow, BYOK steps, timeline, and estimate.
Anand (AtlasPay): 9am CET good.
DeployBot: Intake ticket #SF-4789 created and linked to thread.
Lena: I'll update CRM stage to "security intake -> awaiting artifacts".
Priya (Security): Starting questionnaire pass now. Will post inline comments and a short checklist when done. If any high-risk control requires design changes I'll call it out before kickoff.
Diego (SE): Adding a short config template to the share for the POC: ```
# POC config
deployment: hosted
region: eu-west-1
kms: customer-managed (BYOK)
gpu_pool: optional
expected_qps: 10
```
Lena: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post artifacts when uploaded. :thumbsup:
